component.name: nextcloud
component.description: TAPPaaS module nextcloud: triage of its own critical/high CVEs (#788). Nextcloud 35 on NixOS (php-fpm behind a local nginx on :80, plain HTTP), published to the internet through the firewall's Caddy as cloud.hrossen.dk; also whiteboard on :3002 and PostgreSQL on localhost. Verified live on hrossen: redis-nextcloud listens only on /run/redis-nextcloud/redis.sock (port 0), no containers run, and imagemagick/libraw/libtiff are in the closure only via php-imagick, libxslt only via nginx (no xslt directive in nginx.conf). enabledPreviewProviders is the NixOS default list (PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, XBitmap, Krita, WebP, MarkDown, TXT, OpenDocument), none of which uses Imagick; Imagick is used only for generated letter avatars and admin theming images. All listed libraw/libtiff CVEs are fixed in the shipped upstream versions (LibRaw 0.22.1, libtiff 4.7.2), and the ImageMagick ones are 2014/2017 bugs long fixed.

analysis.detail: SUN coder error handling fixed in ImageMagick 6.8.9 (2014); 7.1.2-32 contains the fix, the match comes from a version-less CVE record.
deflate_dng_load_raw integer overflow (TALOS-2026-2364) is fixed in upstream LibRaw 0.22.1 (commit aa4458e, Debian marks 0.22.1-1 fixed); the shipped libraw is 0.22.1.
uncompressed_fp_dng_load_raw overflow (TALOS-2026-2363) is fixed in upstream LibRaw 0.22.1 (commit c911c9b); the shipped libraw is 0.22.1.
Debian/Ubuntu packaging bug (Lua loaded as a dynamic library, exposing package/loadlib); nixpkgs builds redis with its bundled Lua and this Nextcloud instance listens only on a unix socket.
Concerns an unofficial Windows port (dbghelp.dll search path); upstream Redis on Linux is not affected.
Double free in profile.c fixed in 6.9.7-4 / 7.0.4-4; 7.1.2-32 contains the fix.
HuffTable::initval overflow (TALOS-2026-2330) is fixed in upstream LibRaw 0.22.1 (commit 5357bb5); the shipped libraw is 0.22.1.
lossless_jpeg_load_raw overflow (TALOS-2026-2331) is fixed in upstream LibRaw 0.22.1 (commit 75ed2c1); the shipped libraw is 0.22.1.
TIFFReadRGBATileExt heap overflow fixed by commit 5155851 (MR 546), first released in libtiff 4.7.0; the shipped libtiff is 4.7.2.
putcontig8bitYCbCr44tile overflow fixed by commit 782a11d6, which is in the v4.7.2 tag (Debian marks 4.7.2-1 fixed); the shipped libtiff is 4.7.2.

libxslt is only linked into nginx's built-in xslt filter, and the nextcloud nginx.conf has no xslt_stylesheet directive, so no XSLT is ever run; the libxml2 it links (2.15.4) also carries the upstream mitigation (>= 2.14.5).
